name: Robin AI
tagline: AI copilot for drafting, reviewing and negotiating contracts.
description: Robin AI is a legal AI platform for contract drafting, review and negotiation, used by in-house legal teams and large enterprises. Its Contract Copilot works in a web app and a Microsoft Word add-in, and a natural-language query layer searches across an entire contract repository. It pairs Anthropic's Claude with proprietary data from millions of contracts to extract terms and flag risks.
insight: One of Anthropic's first legal launch partners; its contract copilot runs on Claude layered over data from 2M+ contracts.

modelSupport.notes: Contract copilot built on Anthropic's Claude, layered over proprietary contract data.

edge: Works inside Microsoft Word and runs natural-language search across your entire contract repository, not just one document at a time.
pros: Extracts terms and flags contract risks
Built on Claude with proprietary data
Drafting, review, and negotiation in one
Used by large enterprises and banks
cons: Less suited to litigation or legal research
